messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Inactive ingredients (single-dose pens and vials):

Sodium phosphate dibasic heptahydrate
Water for injection
Hydrochloric acid and/or sodium hydroxide (added to adjust pH)

Benzyl alcohol
Glycerin
Phenol
Triplet: ["tirzepatide", "is active ingredient of", "Zepbound"]

The relation 'is active ingredient of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject substance serves as the active pharmaceutical ingredient in the drug specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
B. 'is salt form of': The subject drug is a specific salt form of the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
C. 'has formulation': The subject drug is available in the specific formulation specified by the object entity.
D. 'may have added': The subject drug may have the substance specified by the object entity added to it.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
